fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'TestProjection|TestWorkspace|TestWritesThroughIndexMatchFold$|TestCarve$|TestLogCarve$|TestReviewCheckQuestionInNodeChangeSet$|TestOtherRoot' passes. A new test in projection_test.go opens a workspace with openWorkspace and no projection under a ctx whose TMPDIR is a fresh t.TempDir(): (failure case) its changeSets() answers nothing and projectionFailure() is an error naming the missing projection, and no rhiza-projection-* folder is created in that TMPDIR or by the call at all. Run with TMPDIR set to a fresh scratch folder, the five named leaking tests TestWritesThroughIndexMatchFold, TestCarve, TestLogCarve, TestReviewCheckQuestionInNodeChangeSet (through ctxWorkspace) and TestWorkspace (through testWorkspace) leave no rhiza-projection-* folder in /tmp whose index.db-wal names that scratch folder (on current code, each run alone, they leave 25, 21, 1, 4 and 7). ctxWorkspace closes its projection when its caller is done, at the latest in a t.Cleanup registered after guardProjections's, so guardProjections still reports a projection left open.
fields.files: internal/api/projection.go:120-140, internal/api/projection_test.go, internal/api/change_test.go (ctxWorkspace and its openWorkspace calls), internal/api/workspace_test.go, internal/api/other_root_index_test.go
fields.must_not: Change openWriteIndex's throwaway folder location or its removal on close and on a failed open; change the production callers of openWorkspace (status.go, run_model_cache.go, openCtxWorkspace, openRootWorkspace) beyond what the fallback's removal needs; change cmd/rhiza; delete or skip any test
fields.statement: A workspace opened with no projection never opens a throwaway index over a bare Ctx: workspace.projection() with none given answers a failed projection naming the missing projection, and the test helpers that open workspaces give it a projection and close it, so no test leaves a rhiza-projection-* folder in the real /tmp. ctxWorkspace and the direct openWorkspace calls in tests that have a Ctx give it their Ctx's projection (useProjection(ctx)); testWorkspace, which has no Ctx, builds one over its root, clock and generator whose Getenv answers a fresh t.TempDir() for TMPDIR, gives the workspace that Ctx's projection, and closes it in a t.Cleanup
